sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS day, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS m FROM orders.orders o  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-09-14' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-09-22' GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(avg(m) FILTER (WHERE day >= DATE '2017-09-21'), 4) AS value, round(avg(m) FILTER (WHERE day < DATE '2017-09-21'), 4) AS baseline, round(stddev_samp(m) FILTER (WHERE day < DATE '2017-09-21'), 4) AS spread, sum(m) FILTER (WHERE day >= DATE '2017-09-21') AS n, sum(m) FILTER (WHERE day < DATE '2017-09-21') AS n_baseline FROM d
